description: American Rivers: Increasing Community and Ecological resilience by Removing a Patapsco River Fish Barrier is a case study listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by American Rivers; NOAA, National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration; USFWS, U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service. American Rivers created an adaptive management plan to help mitigate and respond to potential risks that could occur while removing the Patapsco River’s Bloede Dam, a significant barrier to river flow and fish passage. Coverage: the United States (2022). The listed link gives the documented application. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the cited source documents and the outcomes reported were not checked, and no model or dataset used was verified. It can support comparison with similar adaptation projects and planning precedents. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
